Loss report: woodpecker -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker pipeline.finally: hooks on the jobs of the chain (the finally jobs run as hooks of the sink job build, the only job that no other job needs; the other jobs of the chain run the failure and always finally jobs in their on_failure hook, because a failed job stops the jobs after it)
